eyebrow.zh: 从 Claude Code 或 Codex 日志提取修改声明，与记录中的文件变化对照并展示证据。
eyebrow.en: Extract change claims from Claude Code or Codex logs, compare them with recorded file changes, and inspect the evidence.

headline.zh:
说过修复了什么，
就回到编辑记录核对
headline.en:
A fix was claimed.
Check the recorded edit.

sub.zh: 从 Claude Code 或 Codex 日志提取修改声明，与记录中的文件变化对照并展示证据。
sub.en: Extract change claims from Claude Code or Codex logs, compare them with recorded file changes, and inspect the evidence.

caption.zh: 声明 · 修改 · 证据

body.zh: 声明关联到目标路径和记录的修改。
body.en: Claims connect to target paths and recorded changes.

body.zh: 报告保留文本、AST 或路径匹配原因。
body.en: Reports retain text, AST and path-matching reasons.

body.zh: 离线规则无需模型 key，也不上传日志。
body.en: Offline rules need no model key and do not upload logs.

title.zh: 缩短从总结回到修改的距离
title.en: Connect the summary to the edits

body.zh: 会话结束时的自然语言总结可能与工具日志不一致。agentlie 把 fix、add、remove、rename、update 声明关联到目标路径及当轮修改，用规则给出 PASS、VAGUE 或 LIE 标签和证据，帮助人工复查。标签不是对 Agent 主观意图的判断。
body.en: A session summary can disagree with its tool log. agentlie connects fix, add, remove, rename and update claims to target paths and recorded edits, then reports PASS, VAGUE or LIE with rule-based evidence for review. These labels do not determine an agent’s intent.

body.zh: 实际检查一条人为构造的会话，得到 7 个声明：3 PASS、2 VAGUE、2 LIE。没有执行 Agent、重放 shell 动作或证明代码功能已正确。
body.en: The real check of a deliberately constructed transcript yields seven claims: three PASS, two VAGUE and two LIE. It does not execute an agent, replay shell actions or prove the code works.

alt.zh: 实际检查一条人为构造的会话，得到 7 个声明：3 PASS、2 VAGUE、2 LIE。没有执行 Agent、重放 shell 动作或证明代码功能已正确。
alt.en: The real check of a deliberately constructed transcript yields seven claims: three PASS, two VAGUE and two LIE. It does not execute an agent, replay shell actions or prove the code works.

body.zh: parser.py 和 codex.py 还原会话及文件前后态，extractor.py 提取声明，verifier.py 比较路径、文本和可用 tree-sitter AST 节点变化，report.py 生成表格或 JSON。默认离线模式不调用模型。
body.en: parser.py and codex.py reconstruct sessions and before/after file states. extractor.py extracts claims; verifier.py compares paths, text and available tree-sitter AST deltas; report.py emits tables or JSON. Default offline mode makes no model calls.

alt.zh: parser.py 和 codex.py 还原会话及文件前后态，extractor.py 提取声明，verifier.py 比较路径、文本和可用 tree-sitter AST 节点变化，report.py 生成表格或 JSON。默认离线模式不调用模型。
alt.en: parser.py and codex.py reconstruct sessions and before/after file states. extractor.py extracts claims; verifier.py compares paths, text and available tree-sitter AST deltas; report.py emits tables or JSON. Default offline mode makes no model calls.

body.zh: 检查依赖日志完整性与修改重建。PASS 表示满足所用规则，VAGUE 表示证据不足或声明难以核对，LIE 表示命中反证规则；都应连同 evidence 查看。
body.en: Checks depend on log completeness and edit reconstruction. PASS satisfies the applied rule, VAGUE indicates insufficient or ambiguous evidence, and LIE matches a contradiction rule. Read each with its evidence.

alt.zh: 检查依赖日志完整性与修改重建。PASS 表示满足所用规则，VAGUE 表示证据不足或声明难以核对，LIE 表示命中反证规则；都应连同 evidence 查看。
alt.en: Checks depend on log completeness and edit reconstruction. PASS satisfies the applied rule, VAGUE indicates insufficient or ambiguous evidence, and LIE matches a contradiction rule. Read each with its evidence.

body.zh: LIE 是规则输出名，不能据此断言主观欺骗或功能缺陷已被全面证明。
body.en: LIE is a rule label, not a determination of deception or a complete functional diagnosis.

note.zh: 实际检查一条人为构造的会话，得到 7 个声明：3 PASS、2 VAGUE、2 LIE。没有执行 Agent、重放 shell 动作或证明代码功能已正确。
note.en: The real check of a deliberately constructed transcript yields seven claims: three PASS, two VAGUE and two LIE. It does not execute an agent, replay shell actions or prove the code works.

body.zh: 对合成 fixture 的 7 条声明运行真实校验。
body.en: Run the actual verifier on seven claims in the synthetic fixture.

body.zh: 获取相同判定及其 source 和 evidence。
body.en: Inspect the same verdicts with source and evidence fields.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.10+。安装会获取依赖；下面显式 --offline，只读取随仓库提供的日志。
body.en: Requires Python 3.10+. Installation fetches dependencies; the explicit --offline demo only reads a shipped log.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/agentlie.git
cd agentlie
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

python -m agentlie.cli check tests/fixtures/lying_transcript.jsonl --offline
python -m agentlie.cli check tests/fixtures/lying_transcript.jsonl --offline --json

limitations.zh: 声明抽取、文件重建与 AST 计数都是有限的启发式。
limitations.en: Claim extraction, file reconstruction and AST counts are bounded heuristics.

limitations.zh: PASS 不等于测试通过，LIE 也不等于证明了主观欺骗。
limitations.en: PASS is not a passing test, and LIE does not prove deliberate deception.

limitations.zh: 本次未执行可选 LLM 抽取或其他真实会话。
limitations.en: Optional LLM extraction and other real sessions were not exercised.
